scope: QwenWorkCN text-model integration only. Image and video integration are deferred by user decision. No shared multi-app integration redesign.

save_and_restart.save: Connect, reconnect and disconnect persist owned configuration while QwenWork is running. They do not request app exit, restart or paid inference.
save_and_restart.saved_notice: 已保存，重启千问办公后生效。
buttons: 稍后手动重启千问办公
save_and_restart.restart: An explicit click requests normal OS termination. QwenWork owns task interruption, draft and quit confirmation. Reopen only after the app and background processes fully exit.
save_and_restart.cancel_or_refusal: No force kill or duplicate launch. Saved configuration is retained.
save_and_restart.running_work: An already-started native relay retains its loaded connection until its worker or host exits. Saving a new connection or disconnect does not revoke that running relay locally. Fresh relays validate currently saved state.
save_and_restart.billing: Before restart, an existing task may continue using its original model, account/workspace and billing context.

stability_changes: Auxiliary model selection is retained when available, otherwise uses the designated default or stable model-ID ordering.
New route files live outside SDK version directories; existing route receipt paths are retained across runtime upgrades.
Nullable/defaulted/generated native columns and column reordering are compatible; missing core fields, incompatible field types/keys and required fields without defaults are rejected before writes.
SQLite WAL readers can retain their read snapshots while managed connection changes are committed.
Desktop auxiliary relay startup failure does not terminate the SDK worker or restore its official model fallback.
limitations: Complete real Agent task execution across a save and actual native quit confirmation still requires device acceptance.
Some vendor configuration readers may observe persisted fields before a full restart; live hot-switch behavior is not promised.
Windows normal window close can hide the app under vendor settings; if complete exit is not observed, stop and ask for manual exit.
Compatibility checks do not guarantee arbitrary future SDK execution-contract changes. Deep additional product changes require user consultation.
